cards.name: Red Fox
cards.eduText: Red foxes have such sharp hearing they can locate small animals moving under snow or soil.
cards.imagePrompt: a friendly red fox sitting in a meadow

cards.name: Sea Otter
cards.eduText: Sea otters often hold hands while resting so they do not drift apart on the water.
cards.imagePrompt: a cheerful sea otter floating on its back in calm water

cards.name: Emperor Penguin
cards.eduText: Emperor penguin dads balance the egg on their feet under a warm flap of skin to keep it cozy.
cards.imagePrompt: a round emperor penguin standing on ice with a fluffy chick

cards.name: Honey Bee
cards.eduText: Honey bees do a figure-eight 'waggle dance' to tell other bees where to find flowers.
cards.imagePrompt: a fuzzy honey bee hovering beside a bright yellow sunflower

cards.name: Green Tree Frog
cards.eduText: Tree frogs have sticky toe pads that let them cling to smooth leaves and climb.
cards.imagePrompt: a small bright green tree frog perched on a shiny leaf

cards.name: African Elephant
cards.eduText: An elephant's trunk has tens of thousands of muscles, enough to pick up a single blade of grass.
cards.imagePrompt: a gentle african elephant with big ears standing in tall grass

cards.name: Giraffe
cards.eduText: A giraffe has only seven bones in its very long neck — the same number as a human.
cards.imagePrompt: a friendly giraffe with a long neck nibbling leaves from a tall tree

cards.name: Koala
cards.eduText: Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day to save energy from their low-nutrient eucalyptus diet.
cards.imagePrompt: a sleepy koala hugging a eucalyptus branch

cards.name: Chameleon
cards.eduText: Chameleons can move their two eyes in different directions at the same time.
cards.imagePrompt: a colorful chameleon with swiveling eyes on a leafy twig

cards.name: Kangaroo
cards.eduText: Kangaroos use their strong tail like a fifth leg and cannot easily walk backwards.
cards.imagePrompt: a bouncy kangaroo with a joey peeking from its pouch

cards.name: Bottlenose Dolphin
cards.eduText: Each dolphin has its own signature whistle it uses a bit like a name.
cards.imagePrompt: a smiling bottlenose dolphin leaping from sparkling water

cards.name: Raccoon
cards.eduText: Raccoons have very sensitive front paws and often dip their food in water before eating.
cards.imagePrompt: a curious raccoon dipping a berry beside a stream

cards.name: Hedgehog
cards.eduText: When frightened, a hedgehog rolls into a tight ball so its sharp spines point outward.
cards.imagePrompt: a cute hedgehog curled into a spiky ball on soft moss

cards.name: Flamingo
cards.eduText: Flamingos get their pink color from the tiny shrimp and algae that they eat.
cards.imagePrompt: a bright pink flamingo standing on one leg in shallow water

cards.name: Chimpanzee
cards.eduText: Chimpanzees make and use tools, like poking sticks into mounds to fish for termites.
cards.imagePrompt: a clever chimpanzee holding a small stick tool in a jungle

cards.name: Snowy Owl
cards.eduText: Snowy owls have feathers covering their feet to keep warm in the freezing Arctic.
cards.imagePrompt: a fluffy snowy owl with big yellow eyes on a snowy branch

cards.name: Axolotl
cards.eduText: An axolotl can regrow lost body parts, including legs and even parts of its heart and brain.
cards.imagePrompt: a smiling pink axolotl with feathery gills in clear water

cards.name: Red Panda
cards.eduText: Red pandas wrap their long bushy tails around themselves like a blanket to stay warm.
cards.imagePrompt: a fluffy red panda curled on a mossy tree branch

cards.name: Platypus
cards.eduText: The platypus is a mammal that lays eggs and senses prey using tiny electric signals in its bill.
cards.imagePrompt: a quirky platypus with a duck-like bill swimming in a clear creek

cards.name: Octopus
cards.eduText: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
cards.imagePrompt: a friendly orange octopus with curling arms among coral

cards.name: Sloth
cards.eduText: Sloths move so slowly that algae can grow on their fur, helping them blend into the trees.
cards.imagePrompt: a slow smiling sloth hanging from a rainforest branch

cards.name: Arctic Fox
cards.eduText: The Arctic fox's fur turns white in winter and brown in summer to help it stay hidden.
cards.imagePrompt: a fluffy white arctic fox sitting in soft snow

cards.name: Naked Mole-rat
cards.eduText: Naked mole-rats live in underground colonies with a single queen, a bit like bees.
cards.imagePrompt: a funny little naked mole-rat peeking from an underground tunnel

cards.name: Giant Panda
cards.eduText: Giant pandas spend many hours a day eating bamboo, sometimes more than half the day.
cards.imagePrompt: a happy giant panda munching green bamboo

cards.name: Bengal Tiger
cards.eduText: Every tiger's stripe pattern is unique, and the stripes are even on their skin, not just fur.
cards.imagePrompt: a calm bengal tiger resting in a sunny jungle clearing

cards.name: Polar Bear
cards.eduText: Polar bears have black skin under their fur to help soak up the sun's warmth.
cards.imagePrompt: a big gentle polar bear walking across white sea ice

cards.name: Great White Shark
cards.eduText: Great white sharks can sense the tiny electric signals given off by other animals nearby.
cards.imagePrompt: a sleek great white shark gliding through blue ocean

cards.name: Orca
cards.eduText: Orcas, also called killer whales, are actually the largest members of the dolphin family.
cards.imagePrompt: a playful black-and-white orca leaping from the sea

cards.name: Blue Whale
cards.eduText: The blue whale is the largest animal known to have ever lived on Earth.
cards.imagePrompt: a majestic blue whale swimming in deep blue ocean

cards.name: Whale Shark
cards.eduText: The whale shark is the largest fish in the world, yet it feeds mostly on tiny plankton.
cards.imagePrompt: an enormous gentle whale shark with white spots gliding in deep blue water

cards.name: Triceratops
cards.eduText: Triceratops had three horns on its face and a large bony frill around the back of its head.
cards.imagePrompt: a friendly triceratops with three horns standing in a green prehistoric meadow

cards.name: Stegosaurus
cards.eduText: Stegosaurus had tall bony plates along its back and sharp spikes on its tail for defense.
cards.imagePrompt: a gentle stegosaurus with big back plates grazing among ferns

cards.name: Ankylosaurus
cards.eduText: Ankylosaurus was covered in bony armor and swung a heavy club on the end of its tail.
cards.imagePrompt: a sturdy armored ankylosaurus with a club tail walking in a valley

cards.name: Parasaurolophus
cards.eduText: Parasaurolophus had a long hollow head crest that may have let it make trumpet-like calls.
cards.imagePrompt: a friendly parasaurolophus with a long curved head crest near a river

cards.name: Iguanodon
cards.eduText: Iguanodon had a spiky thumb that it may have used for defense or to break open plants.
cards.imagePrompt: a calm iguanodon standing on two legs reaching for leafy plants

cards.name: Gallimimus
cards.eduText: Gallimimus looked a bit like an ostrich and was one of the fastest running dinosaurs.
cards.imagePrompt: a slender ostrich-like gallimimus running across an open plain

cards.name: Pachycephalosaurus
cards.eduText: Pachycephalosaurus had a very thick, domed skull that it may have used for head-butting.
cards.imagePrompt: a pachycephalosaurus with a thick round domed head in a prehistoric forest

cards.name: Protoceratops
cards.eduText: Protoceratops was a sheep-sized relative of Triceratops with a bony frill but no big horns.
cards.imagePrompt: a small sheep-sized protoceratops with a bony frill in a sandy desert

cards.name: Maiasaura
cards.eduText: Maiasaura means 'good mother lizard' — fossils show it looked after its babies in nests.
cards.imagePrompt: a caring maiasaura standing over a nest of eggs

cards.name: Compsognathus
cards.eduText: Compsognathus was about the size of a chicken, one of the smallest dinosaurs known.
cards.imagePrompt: a tiny chicken-sized compsognathus darting across rocks

cards.name: Edmontosaurus
cards.eduText: Edmontosaurus was a large duck-billed dinosaur with hundreds of grinding teeth.
cards.imagePrompt: a large duck-billed edmontosaurus grazing by a river

cards.name: Styracosaurus
cards.eduText: Styracosaurus had a frill lined with long spikes around the back of its head.
cards.imagePrompt: a styracosaurus with a spiky frill of horns in a green valley

cards.name: Corythosaurus
cards.eduText: Corythosaurus had a tall, helmet-shaped crest on top of its head.
cards.imagePrompt: a corythosaurus with a tall helmet-shaped crest near ferns

cards.name: Dryosaurus
cards.eduText: Dryosaurus was a small plant-eater with long back legs built for running fast.
cards.imagePrompt: a small speedy dryosaurus running on two legs across a plain

cards.name: Nigersaurus
cards.eduText: Nigersaurus had a wide, straight-edged mouth with hundreds of tiny teeth for cropping plants.
cards.imagePrompt: a nigersaurus with a wide flat mouth cropping low green plants

cards.name: Velociraptor
cards.eduText: The real Velociraptor was only about the size of a turkey and had feathers.
cards.imagePrompt: a small feathered velociraptor perched alertly on a rock

cards.name: Brachiosaurus
cards.eduText: Brachiosaurus had front legs longer than its back legs, helping it lift its head high to reach treetops.
cards.imagePrompt: a towering gentle brachiosaurus reaching leaves at the top of tall trees

cards.name: Pteranodon
cards.eduText: Pteranodon was a flying reptile with a huge wingspan — but it was a pterosaur, not a true dinosaur.
cards.imagePrompt: a large winged pteranodon with a long head crest gliding over the sea

cards.name: Deinonychus
cards.eduText: Deinonychus had a large sickle-shaped claw on each foot and probably had feathers.
cards.imagePrompt: a feathered deinonychus with a big curved claw crouching alertly

cards.name: Coelophysis
cards.eduText: Coelophysis was a slender, fast hunter and one of the earliest dinosaurs, from the Triassic.
cards.imagePrompt: a slender coelophysis running quickly through Triassic scrubland

cards.name: Oviraptor
cards.eduText: Oviraptor's name means 'egg thief', but it was likely guarding its own eggs, not stealing them.
cards.imagePrompt: a feathered oviraptor gently sitting on a nest of eggs

cards.name: Baryonyx
cards.eduText: Baryonyx had a crocodile-like snout and ate fish, with a big curved claw on each hand.
cards.imagePrompt: a baryonyx with a crocodile-like snout catching a fish in a river

cards.name: Microraptor
cards.eduText: Microraptor was a small feathered dinosaur with wings on all four of its limbs.
cards.imagePrompt: a small feathered microraptor with four wings gliding between trees

cards.name: Spinosaurus
cards.eduText: Spinosaurus is the longest known meat-eating dinosaur and likely spent much of its time hunting fish in water.
cards.imagePrompt: a large spinosaurus with a tall sail on its back wading in a river

cards.name: Allosaurus
cards.eduText: Allosaurus was a powerful Jurassic hunter with saw-edged teeth built for slicing meat.
cards.imagePrompt: a strong allosaurus standing over a rocky Jurassic landscape

cards.name: Therizinosaurus
cards.eduText: Therizinosaurus had some of the longest claws of any animal, up to about a meter long.
cards.imagePrompt: a therizinosaurus with very long curved claws reaching for tall leaves

cards.name: Carnotaurus
cards.eduText: Carnotaurus had two horns above its eyes and tiny arms even shorter than a T. rex's.
cards.imagePrompt: a carnotaurus with two small horns above its eyes and tiny arms

cards.name: Giganotosaurus
cards.eduText: Giganotosaurus was one of the largest meat-eating dinosaurs, even a bit longer than T. rex.
cards.imagePrompt: a huge giganotosaurus roaring in an ancient forest

cards.name: Tyrannosaurus rex
cards.eduText: Tyrannosaurus rex had one of the most powerful bites of any land animal that has ever lived.
cards.imagePrompt: a mighty tyrannosaurus rex roaring in a misty prehistoric forest

cards.name: Argentinosaurus
cards.eduText: Argentinosaurus may be one of the heaviest land animals ever, as heavy as many elephants together.
cards.imagePrompt: a colossal long-necked argentinosaurus towering over the treetops

cards.name: Griffin
cards.eduText: Told of in the ancient Near East and Greece, the griffin has an eagle's head and a lion's body.
cards.imagePrompt: a noble griffin with soft feathered wings standing on a grassy hill

cards.name: Pegasus
cards.eduText: Pegasus is a winged horse from ancient Greek myths who was said to gallop through the sky.
cards.imagePrompt: a white winged horse trotting on a cloud in a blue sky

cards.name: Kappa
cards.eduText: In Japanese folklore, the kappa is a mischievous river creature said to love cucumbers.
cards.imagePrompt: a small friendly green turtle-like river creature holding a cucumber

cards.name: Selkie
cards.eduText: Scottish and Irish folklore tells of selkies, seals who could shed their skin to walk on land as people.
cards.imagePrompt: a gentle seal resting on a rock beside a soft grey sealskin cloak

cards.name: Fenghuang
cards.eduText: The fenghuang is a bird from Chinese mythology, long seen as a symbol of peace and good fortune.
cards.imagePrompt: an elegant bird with long rainbow tail feathers perched on a plum branch

cards.name: Brownie
cards.eduText: In British and Scottish folklore, brownies are helpful house spirits who tidy up in exchange for treats.
cards.imagePrompt: a tiny cheerful house sprite in a brown hood sweeping with a straw broom

cards.name: Mermaid
cards.eduText: Tales of mermaids — half-human, half-fish — appear in folklore all around the world.
cards.imagePrompt: a friendly mermaid with a shimmering tail sitting on a rock by the sea

cards.name: Fairy
cards.eduText: European folklore describes fairies as tiny magical beings, sometimes shown with delicate wings.
cards.imagePrompt: a tiny glowing fairy with delicate wings among flowers

cards.name: Gnome
cards.eduText: In Renaissance folklore, gnomes are small earth spirits said to live underground.
cards.imagePrompt: a cheerful little gnome with a pointed red hat in a garden

cards.name: Troll
cards.eduText: Norse and Scandinavian folklore tell of trolls, large creatures said to live in mountains or caves.
cards.imagePrompt: a big friendly troll sitting among mossy mountain boulders

cards.name: Goblin
cards.eduText: European folklore describes goblins as small, mischievous creatures.
cards.imagePrompt: a small mischievous goblin grinning in a torch-lit cave

cards.name: Centaur
cards.eduText: In Greek mythology, a centaur has the upper body of a human and the body of a horse.
cards.imagePrompt: a noble centaur, half human and half horse, standing in a meadow

cards.name: Minotaur
cards.eduText: Greek myth tells of the Minotaur, a creature with a bull's head kept in a maze called the Labyrinth.
cards.imagePrompt: a strong minotaur with a bull's head standing at the entrance of a maze

cards.name: Cyclops
cards.eduText: In Greek mythology, the Cyclopes were giants with a single eye in the middle of the forehead.
cards.imagePrompt: a giant one-eyed cyclops resting beside a rocky hillside

cards.name: Satyr
cards.eduText: Greek myth describes satyrs as playful nature spirits, part human and part goat.
cards.imagePrompt: a playful satyr with goat legs holding pan pipes in a forest

cards.name: Unicorn
cards.eduText: Legends across many cultures describe the unicorn, a horse-like creature with a single spiraling horn.
cards.imagePrompt: a gentle white unicorn with a spiral horn in a field of wildflowers

cards.name: Kirin
cards.eduText: The qilin (kirin) of East Asian legend is a gentle mythical creature whose appearance was seen as a good omen.
cards.imagePrompt: a graceful deer-like creature with golden scales and gentle antlers

cards.name: Thunderbird
cards.eduText: Many Indigenous peoples of North America tell of the thunderbird, a great bird linked to storms and rain.
cards.imagePrompt: a huge majestic bird with wide patterned wings gliding above green hills

cards.name: Sphinx
cards.eduText: The sphinx of Greek myth had a lion's body and a human head, and was famous for asking riddles.
cards.imagePrompt: a majestic sphinx with a lion's body and a calm human face

cards.name: Hydra
cards.eduText: In Greek myth, the Hydra was a serpent that grew two new heads whenever one was cut off.
cards.imagePrompt: a many-headed serpent hydra rising from a misty swamp

cards.name: Basilisk
cards.eduText: European legend tells of the basilisk, a serpent said to be the 'king of serpents'.
cards.imagePrompt: a green serpent basilisk with a small crown-like crest

cards.name: Yeti
cards.eduText: Himalayan folklore tells of the Yeti, a large ape-like creature said to live in the snowy mountains.
cards.imagePrompt: a big furry white yeti walking through snowy mountains

cards.name: Banshee
cards.eduText: In Irish folklore, the banshee is a spirit whose wailing cry was said to be an omen.
cards.imagePrompt: a pale ghostly banshee floating over misty green Irish hills

cards.name: Sky Dragon
cards.eduText: In Chinese mythology, dragons are wise, benevolent beings often connected with water and rain.
cards.imagePrompt: a long friendly serpent dragon with flowing whiskers curling through clouds

cards.name: Phoenix
cards.eduText: The phoenix is a mythical bird said to be reborn from its own ashes, an ancient symbol of renewal.
cards.imagePrompt: a beautiful bird with warm orange and gold feathers rising into sunlight

cards.name: Kraken
cards.eduText: Scandinavian legends tell of the Kraken, a giant sea monster said to rise up near ships.
cards.imagePrompt: a giant kraken sea monster with huge tentacles rising near a wooden ship

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.eduText: In Greek myth, Cerberus was a many-headed dog who guarded the gates of the underworld.
cards.imagePrompt: a three-headed dog cerberus guarding a shadowy gate

cards.name: Roc
cards.eduText: Middle Eastern legends describe the Roc, a bird so enormous it was said to carry off elephants.
cards.imagePrompt: an enormous roc bird with vast wings soaring over mountains

cards.name: World Turtle
cards.eduText: The World Turtle appears in myths from several cultures, picturing the world resting on a giant turtle's back.
cards.imagePrompt: an enormous calm turtle with a green island and tiny trees on its shell

cards.name: Leviathan
cards.eduText: The Leviathan is a giant sea creature described in ancient Hebrew texts.
cards.imagePrompt: a colossal sea creature leviathan coiling through deep dark ocean
